description: "Tom, Dick and Harry" by Talbot Baines Reed is a fictional novel written in the late 19th century. The book follows young Master Jones, affectionately nicknamed "Sarah" by his peers at Dangerfield College, as he navigates the ups and downs of school life, friendships, and mishaps.
